note: exact_acc == MRR@10 over file-level targets (a regression gate, not an absolute benchmark: the generation-time self-retrieval filter admits only questions the retriever already answers at rank <= 10, so found_rate starts at 1.0 by construction). Tolerance 0.05: scoring is deterministic on a fixed index, but the index churns with the code; the gate targets the silently-broken-embedder/index class. Regenerate the suite (scripts/generate_retrieval_eval_data.py) when errors exceed ~10% of n. Re-locked 2026-07-21 after fixing the CodebaseIndexer duplicate-chunk-id bug (PR #186): the index now covers all 554 files instead of silently dropping 77, so this lower MRR (0.6593 vs prior 0.7535) reflects the full corpus being scored honestly, not a real regression.
